{{Top|leg}}
"'''Private Property'''" was the name of a music track created by [[Boo Rawl]], a [[Free-trader|freight-hauler]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It showcased his sarcastic wit and his penchant for turning phrases into anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sayings.<ref name="Slaying">{{JournalCite|9|Slaying Dragons}}</ref>
